content: {"praised":["Kate Beckinsale delivers a strong performance.","Visuals showcase stunning Antarctic landscapes.","The film is a good murder mystery.","Suspenseful atmosphere created by harsh weather.","Good roles for Kate and Tom Skerritt."],"criticized":["Script is dismal and confusing.","Acting is terrible and unconvincing.","Plot feels like a mash‑up of other films.","Story is boring and lacks supernatural element.","Pacing is downhill after opening scene."]}
